title: Component/Token Relationship (CTR) file
description: Layer 1 — structural shape of a relationships/*.json file: a JSON array of Component/Token Relationship (CTR) entries. Graph rules (option-value validity, component/part/state existence, $ref resolution) are Layer 2. See spec/relationship-format.md.

lifecycle.description: Version lifecycle metadata, mirroring the token/component lifecycle pattern (see token.schema.json).

introduced.description: Spec version when this relationship was added (e.g. "1.0.0-draft").

deprecatedIn.description: Spec version when the relationship was deprecated (e.g. "3.2.0"). Truthy = deprecated.

deprecatedComment.description: Human-readable deprecation explanation and migration guidance.

replacedBy.description: UUID(s) of the replacement relationship(s). Array form requires deprecatedComment.

plannedRemoval.description: Spec version when the relationship will be removed.

scope.description: Explicit relationship context: which component, part, and property this CTR describes, plus any option-scoped narrowing. Layer 1 only enforces shape here — that `component.<part>` exists, that `options.<key>` values validate against the referenced component's declared option values, and that `property` matches a registered property term are Layer 2 rules (see spec/relationship-format.md).

component.description: Component name (kebab-case). MUST match a declared component name (SPEC-051).

part.description: Anatomy part name within the component. MUST match a declared anatomy part when present (SPEC-052).

property.description: The stylistic attribute this relationship describes (e.g. color, width, padding).

options.description: Option-scoped narrowing (e.g. variant, size, style, arbitrary component option keys). Each string value MUST validate against the referenced component's options.<key>.values (SPEC-053); a boolean option (for example isSelected) takes `true` or `false`; an array matches when any listed value matches. `state` is the exception: an ordered array of atomic state ids validated against the component's declared states (SPEC-054).

state.description: Ordered array of atomic state ids (e.g. ["hover"], ["selected", "hover"]).

context.description: Label for how this CTR is used (mirrors tokenBindings[].context; maps to a Figma Token Group label). A visual recipe binds on this exact string (trimmed), so it is an identity key. Grammar: a main word (or a compound of main words) with an optional parenthesised part or qualifier. The main word is checked against registry/relationship-contexts.json (SPEC-091).

contextRole.description: Registry term ids (registry/relationship-contexts.json) for the main word of `context`, in order. Several ids make a compound main word, for example ["background", "border"] for `Background and border`. When `context` is also present it MUST equal the label derived from these fields (SPEC-090).

contextPart.description: The parenthesised part of `context`, such as an anatomy part (`Dot`) or a pair of parts (`icon to label`). Mutually exclusive with contextQualifier. Requires contextRole.

contextQualifier.description: The parenthesised qualifier of `context`, such as `semantic`, `default` or `minimum`. Mutually exclusive with contextPart. Requires contextRole.

$valueType.description: URI reference to a value-type schema under schemas/value-types/. When present, value MUST validate against the referenced schema.

value.description: Literal value owned by this CTR; type narrowed by value-type schemas where applicable.

uuid.description: Required stable identity (SPEC-084). MUST be globally unique across all relationship entries in the same layer (SPEC-056) and never change once assigned.

description.description: Plain text describing the relationship's purpose.

legacyKey.description: Interim/transitional: pins the exact flat key written to legacy output (packages/tokens/src) for CTRs that must round-trip through the legacy generator. Not required for CTRs with no legacy counterpart. See spec/relationship-format.md#legacy-fields.

setUuid.description: Interim/transitional: identifies the legacy color-set entry this CTR belongs to, for color-set legacy output reconstruction. Only present alongside legacyKey.

setSchema.description: Interim/transitional: names the legacy color-set schema this CTR's set entry conforms to. Only present alongside setUuid.

The main word is checked against registry/relationship-contexts.json (SPEC-091).

$ref.description: Alias target. MUST resolve to a token or relationship UUID in the dataset (SPEC-055).
